interface.title: Migration Analysis Dashboard
interface.field: Movement ecology / animal biotelemetry (GPS tracking of snow geese, accelerometry of hammer-headed bats)
interface.stage_of_work: Exploring and checking the quality of tracking data that has already been collected
interface.what_it_is_for: Pick one tagged bird or bat and see its route, distance and speed summaries, daily and hourly movement, and accelerometer bursts, so that implausible GPS fixes and sensor glitches stand out.

data.note: Pre-seeded Movebank-style data with no uploads: birds 91732A and 91733A (Anser caerulescens, 2013-03-01 to 2013-03-06) and bats bat01 and bat02 (Hypsignathus monstrosus, 2013-06-01/02). Map tiles from OpenStreetMap loaded in most screens, but some screens (006, 026) show grey tiles because they were captured while tiles were still loading. Bird 91732A has a planted GPS outlier on 2013-03-04, and bat01 has a planted 9999 sensor spike in the 2013-06-02 08:05 burst.

features.name: Individual picker driving a per-animal summary dashboard
features.general: Choose a data source and one subject, and every summary card and plot on the page recomputes for that subject
features.specific: Choose Bird Migration or Bat Activity with the radio, then a Bird ID or Bat ID; the metrics, route map and plots redraw for that animal
steps: choose dataset type with the radio
choose the individual ID from the dropdown
read the metric cards (days, total distance, avg daily distance, start/end, tag)
switch to a second individual to compare
serves_tasks: Choose which kind of tracking data to look at
Get summary distance, duration and speed for an individual

features.name: Pannable track map
features.general: Draw a GPS track as a line on a pannable, zoomable basemap so its overall shape and any long straight detours can be seen
features.specific: Leaflet Migration Route red polyline (zoom +/−, drag to pan); 91732A's track shows a straight jump north to ~41°N. Clicking the line gives no popup or per-fix information
steps: select a bird
zoom out or pan the map to see the full track
zoom in on a segment
serves_tasks: View a track on an interactive map
Match a jump in per-day distance to the track segment that causes it

features.name: Per-day distance series
features.general: Sum step distances between consecutive fixes by calendar day and plot them against date, so a day with an implausible total stands out
features.specific: Daily Distance Traveled line plot (haversine step distances summed per date), shown beside the route map but not linked to it; 91732A peaks at ~2270 km on 2013-03-04, 91733A stays flat near 27.3 km/day
steps: select a bird
read the daily-distance series for the day with the spike
open the plot fullscreen to read values
switch to another bird to compare
serves_tasks: Match a jump in per-day distance to the track segment that causes it

features.name: Burst selector with tri-axial acceleration and intensity traces
features.general: Choose one recording burst by timestamp to plot its raw multi-axis signal and the derived magnitude, showing how intensely the subject moved and making sensor glitches show up as spikes
features.specific: 'Select Timestamp for Detailed Analysis' dropdown drives the Acceleration Pattern (X/Y/Z per sample) and Movement Intensity plots; bat01 08:05 shows the 9999 spike
steps: select a bat
open the timestamp dropdown and pick a burst
read X/Y/Z traces and the intensity trace
open a trace fullscreen
pick another burst or bat to compare
serves_tasks: Inspect one accelerometer burst's per-axis signal and overall intensity

features.name: Toggleable value-distribution histogram
features.general: Turn on an optional histogram of all derived values for the subject to see the spread and any values far from the rest
features.specific: 'Show Movement Statistics' checkbox reveals the Distribution of Movement Intensities across all of a bat's samples
steps: tick the checkbox
read where the bulk and any isolated bars lie
switch individual and compare
untick to hide
serves_tasks: Summarise the distribution of movement intensity across all bursts

features.name: Time-of-day record histogram
features.general: Bin each record by its hour of day to show when the subject was recorded
features.specific: Bird 'Movement Patterns' (Number of Movements by Hour of Day, i.e. GPS fixes per hour) and bat 'Activity Distribution Throughout Day'
steps: select an individual
scroll to the hourly histogram
compare peaks across individuals or species
serves_tasks: Count records by hour of day

features.name: Covariate correlation heatmap
features.general: Show a labelled correlation matrix of environmental variables recorded along a track, with a colour bar
features.specific: Environmental Factors Impact heatmap of ECMWF low vs high vegetation cover for the chosen bird, viewable fullscreen
steps: select a bird
read the coefficients in the matrix
open fullscreen for legible labels
serves_tasks: Look at correlation among environmental covariates

screens_never_reached: Route popups or point markers: clicking the polyline did nothing (screens/010.webp), and clicking one of the 8 map path elements by ref timed out, so the map shows no per-fix information
not_done: Clicking the route line on the map did nothing: no popup appeared (screens/010.webp), so it was removed from the map task.

Correlating movement with vegetation cover: the heatmap only correlates low vegetation cover with high vegetation cover (screens/030.webp). Neither distance nor speed is included, so movement against covariates cannot be assessed in the interface.
Average daily speed as its own number: the only measure shown is 'Avg. Daily Distance' in km/day. There is no speed in km/h and no per-step speed plot.
The missing vegetation-cover value in 91732A is never reported as missing. The heatmap still shows r = 0.93, so the gap was presumably dropped without any notice.
Removing or flagging outliers: there is no control to exclude the GPS glitch or the 9999 burst and recompute totals, so 91732A's 2525 km total and 420.8 km/day include the glitch.
No export or download controls exist, so no results could be saved.

During reruns after a dataset switch, the page briefly showed stale mixed content: bird metrics and a bird ID dropdown inside the bat view (screens/013.webp), and a bat checkbox, missing plots and grey tiles inside the bird view (screens/026.webp). Both cleared once the run finished; 026 is no longer cited as evidence.
Only the timestamps 2013-06-01 20:00 and 2013-06-02 08:05 were opened for bat01, and only 21:00 for bat02. The other bursts were not inspected.
The bat recording summary cards (Recording Duration, Total Measurements, Start/End Time) were not read or recorded during the run.
